Ranks Montgomery census tracts by the number of food establishments whose latest inspection score is below 85, also returning each tract's total inspected establishments, with all tracts included via LEFT JOIN and geoid last for mapping.
sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    entity_key,
    CAST(value AS DOUBLE) AS inspection_score
  FROM (
    SELECT
      geoid,
      entity_key,
      value,
      event_date,
      record_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_key ORDER BY event_date DESC, record_id) AS rn
    FROM fw_pg.tract_observations
    WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_f11792'
      AND source = 'm1_city'
      AND value_kind = 'score'
      AND geoid IS NOT NULL
      AND value IS NOT NULL
  ) ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  t.name AS tract_name,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN l.inspection_score < 85 THEN 1 END) AS below_85_count,
  COUNT(l.entity_key) AS total_inspected_establishments,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN latest l ON t.geoid = l.geoid
GROUP BY t.name, t.geoid
ORDER BY below_85_count DESC, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200
